findings.title: Non-cash consulting revenues are non-recurring, event-driven transactions associated with specific onboarding campaigns
findings.description: Non-cash consulting revenues are non-recurring, event-driven transactions associated with specific onboarding campaigns (such as the CountSharp, CupCrew, HeadFarm, and RealWorld deals) rather than continuous services, meaning that Q1 non-cash revenues represent almost the entire yearly totals and linear extrapolation would dramatically overestimate full-year numbers.

findings.title: Based on the Q1 FY2024 Form 10-Q statement of cash flows, which reports 'Receipt of equity in lieu of cash' of $1,170,00
findings.description: Based on the Q1 FY2024 Form 10-Q statement of cash flows, which reports 'Receipt of equity in lieu of cash' of $1,170,000 for the three months ended July 31, 2023, and $1,200,000 for the three months ended July 31, 2022, a linear extrapolation assumes constant quarterly non-cash revenue, estimating full-year totals of $4,800,000 for FY2023 and $4,680,000 for FY2024.

findings.title: Netcapital artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income through non-cash consulting transactions valued at
findings.description: Netcapital artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income through non-cash consulting transactions valued at up to 117 times the standard rate card, using repetitive or templated equity-for-services agreements that did not reflect genuine economic substance.

findings.description: The details of the crowdfunding offerings for CountSharp LLC, CupCrew LLC, HeadFarm LLC, and RealWorld LLC, including their launch dates, target amounts, and actual amounts raised on the Netcapital portal, are entirely absent from the provided corporate filings and portal records, meaning their existence and active status cannot be verified from the corpus.
